text: おまえ　なんかにゃ　まけたり　しないよ

structure.jp: おまえ　なんかにゃ
まけたり　しないよ
structure.en: she won't do anything like lose

patterns.name: 〜たりしない
patterns.span: まけたり　しないよ
patterns.explanation: たり plus しない says someone would not do such a thing at all. まけたり　しない = 'won't do anything like lose'.

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.span: おまえ　なんかにゃ
patterns.explanation: なんか after a person or thing shows you look down on it. おまえ　なんか = 'the likes of you'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: にゃ is a rough spoken squashing of には. It shows who she would lose to and singles that person out. おまえ　なんかにゃ = 'to the likes of you, at least'.
